import re, csv
from decimal import Decimal as D
txt = open("oct_bank_check.txt").read()
rows = []
for line in txt.splitlines():
    m = re.match(r"\s*(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4})\s+(.+?)\s{2,}\$([\d,]+\.\d{2})\s+\$([\d,]+\.\d{2})\s*$", line)
    if m: rows.append((m.group(1), m.group(2).strip(), D(m.group(3).replace(",","")), D(m.group(4).replace(",",""))))
bal = D("93280"); tbl = []
first = {d: i for i,(d,_,_,_) in enumerate(rows,1)}
for i,(d,desc,amt,stated) in enumerate(rows,1):
    if abs(bal-amt-stated) < D("0.005"):
        nb = bal-amt; kind="wd"; dr, cr = f"{amt:,.2f}", ""
    else:
        nb = bal+amt; kind="dp"; dr, cr = "", f"{amt:,.2f}"
    tbl.append((i, d, desc, dr, cr, f"{nb:,.2f}", f"{stated:,.2f}")); bal = nb
# row numbers for narrative
def rowno(name): return first[name]
body = "\n".join(f"| {i} | {d[:5]} | {desc} | {dr} | {cr} | {nb} | {st} |" for i,d,desc,dr,cr,nb,st in tbl)
open("oct_recon_body.md","w").write(body)
print("rows", len(rows), "final", bal)
# deposit dates span
dd = sorted({d for d,desc,amt,s in rows if (d,desc) and not any(x==desc for x,_ in [])} )
EOF

8:     - **What happened:** despite C-012 Alder Studios LLC's 08/11 written cancellation effective 08/31 (item 16) and its explicit "please stop invoicing after the August invoice," the billing system issued **INV-2409, 1,800.00, dated 2025-09-01, "Monthly subscription — September 2025"** to C-012. The customer wrote back 09/06 (`documents/month_09/email_dispute_C-012.txt`): "We received another invoice. We cancelled effective 8/31 (see our notice). **We will not be paying this. Please issue a credit and stop.**"
9:     - **September accounting:** the billing run was posted gross as issued (JE-2025-09-01, A/R/4000 30,450.00, all 24 invoices) and INV-2409 was then **credited in full — Dr 4000 / Cr 1100 1,800.00, JE-2025-09-02 dated 09/06** — per revenue_policy_memo #3 ("Cancelled contracts: no revenue after the effective cancellation date; invoices issued in error are credited") and ASC 606-10-25-1: with the contract ended 08/31 there is **no September contract with C-012, no performance obligation, and no revenue**; the invoice alone creates none. Net September recurring billings are therefore **28,650.00 across 23 customers** — exactly the run-rate item 16 predicted.
10:     - **No downstream residue — every leg verified:** the bank shows **no 1,800.00 deposit from Alder Studios LLC** (all 32 statement lines recomputed; the only Alder deposit is C-018's 900.00); the credit zeroes the receivable so INV-2409 **never ages in A/R** (A/R proof: 92,650.00 + 30,450.00 + 27,000.00 − 1,800.00 − 55,650.00 = 92,650.00); and revenue is stated net of the credit. September's books are right; the error died inside the month — hence no ASC 250 question.
11:     - **Control observation for management (disclosure, not an entry):** a cancelled customer was re-billed — and re-billing a churned customer costs goodwill (this is their second email). Management should confirm the billing-system suppression of C-012 and that **October's run contains no C-012 line and still contains C-018** (Alder Studios **Inc**, 900.00/month — a different, continuing customer; the name trap must not be suppressed by over-correction). No accounting content; monitored at the October close.
12:     - **Name trap re-guarded:** C-018 Alder Studios Inc was correctly billed (INV-2415) and paid 900.00 on 09/20 (bank row 9). Only the LLC was cancelled.
13: 
14: 18. **Vireo Clinics PBC (C-030) INV-2422 — 27,000.00 annual prepay; NEW customer, first of twelve 2,250.00 releases booked in September; 27,000.00 − 2,250.00 = 24,750.00 remains.**
15:     - **The documents:** `documents/month_09/order_form_C-030.md` — annual subscription 27,000.00 billed upfront, **service start 2025-09-01, term 12 months, auto-renewing**, due on signature, "Governed by the Northwind Master Subscription Agreement (v3.2)," signed electronically 09/01; INV-2422 27,000.00 dated 09/01; **WIRE IN 27,000.00 on 09/15** — the statement's only wire (all subscription collections are ACH), so the prepay is collected in full.
16:     - **Accounting:** deferred at billing (Dr 1100 / Cr 2200 27,000.00, JE-2025-09-03), 1/12 monthly from the 09/01 service start per revenue_policy_memo #1, ASC 606-10-45-2 and the time-based-series guidance ASC 606-10-55-51 — first release **2,250.00** in September (JE-2025-09-04, part of the 13,050.00 total). The invoice description ("billed upfront") does not set the timing: cash receipt creates no revenue (ASC 606-10-45-2); releases run Sep 2025–Aug 2026. Arithmetic: 27,000.00 ÷ 12 = 2,250.00; closing 24,750.00 ✓ (roll-forward line verified).
17:     - **Gap still open (stated, not asked):** "MSA v3.2" is not in the file — same documentation gap as items 1/13/14 (and the item-16 cancellation email). All release inputs (price, start, term) are on the order form itself, so the treatment does not depend on the MSA; the auto-renew clause likewise has no September accounting effect (renewal is optional and would create a new option period, not more 2025 performance). If the MSA ever surfaces and contradicts the order form, revisit.
18:     - **Business context (disclosure, not an entry):** the 27,000.00 prepay arrives the same month as the first churn (item 16) — one customer out at 1,800.00/month, one in at a 2,250.00/month equivalent, plus the 17,420.00 opening A/P still unpaid. The Board should read items 7, 8, 16 and 18 together when assessing the business.
19: 
20: ## Closed this month
21: 
22: 2. **Harbor Law LLP — CLOSED. The third bill arrived and the pattern resolves: quarterly, always on the 9th.** `documents/month_09/vendor_bills.csv` carries **2025-09-09, Harbor Law LLP, 2,500.00, "Professional fees"** — and the bank paid it **same day** (statement row 5, ACH 09/09). The three bill dates — **03/09, 06/09, 09/09** — are exactly one quarter apart, so the "silences" (April/May, July/August) were simply the off-quarters: nothing anomalous ever occurred, and the item's open question ("is this a real, recurring vendor and what is it for?") is answered as far as the file can answer it. Cumulative charges stand at **7,500.00 (3 × 2,500.00) in 5400**; the 5400 cumulative proves the history: 240.00 × 9 Gusto months = 2,160.00 + 7,500.00 = **9,660.00** = September TB 5400 ✓. **Classification unchanged and final:** 5400 G&A — other, because the controller-assigned chart (item 11, which stays open) has **no professional-fees code** and no Board direction to add one has been given; that ongoing mapping question lives in item 11, not here. The engagement letter has never been in the file — final stated assumption: the bills are legitimate legal services for the periods billed, payment by same-day ACH corroborates. No ASC 250 question — the charges were recorded in every month they arrived, to the penny, from the start.

24: ## Carried forward (client had no additional information; all remain stated assumptions)

26: 1. **C-027 Marigold Schools Inc INV-2275 — 18,000.00 annual prepay; seventh of twelve 1,500.00 releases booked in September; 9,000.00 − 1,500.00 = 7,500.00 remains** (term 2025-03-01..2026-02-28, order form `documents/month_03/order_form_C-027.md`; releases per revenue_policy_memo #1, ASC 606-10-45-2 and 606-10-25-14(b)/25-27). **Gap still open (stated, not asked):** the referenced "MSA v3.2" is not in the file; the release inputs (price, start, term) are all on the order form itself, so treatment does not depend on it. If the MSA ever surfaces and contradicts the order form, revisit. (Same gap: Quarry — item 13 — Saltline — item 14 — the churn email, item 16 — and now Vireo, item 18.)
27: 
28: 3. **Trestle overlap assumption — renewal ninth of twelve releases booked (2,000.00); closing renewal balance 8,000.00 − 2,000.00 = 6,000.00; still the largest judgment in the books** (month_01 item 2; month_02 item 2; month_03 item 3; month_04 item 3). The stated renewal term (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) overlaps the prior contract Jan–May 2025; if the renewal actually runs Jun 2025–May 2026, cumulative over-recognition on the renewal line remains **frozen at its cap of 10,000.00** (reached end-May) — the exposure cannot grow, only unwind. Remaining 6,000.00 releases Oct–Dec 2025 (3 × 2,000.00) under the order-form reading; under the alternative reading the frozen 10,000.00 unwinds and releases run to May 2026 — **closing 6,000.00 either way at 09/30**.
29: 
30: 5. **24,000.00 unidentified opening deferred revenue** (month_01 item 1) — still $0 recognized; carried in the roll-forward as "UNIDENTIFIED"; will never hit revenue without evidence of performance (ASC 606-10-45-2). No September bank item relates to it (statement fully matched, all 32 lines recomputed; the only unusual credit, the 27,000.00 Vireo wire, is identified to INV-2422 — item 18).
31: 
32: 6. **Opening trial balance oddities** (month_01 item 3) — 4000 opening credit 30,450.00 (2024 revenue never closed) and 3900 debit 205,953.00 (deficit) left exactly as received. Cumulative 4000 at 09/30 = 418,150.00, of which 2025 activity is 387,700.00 = 418,150.00 − 30,450.00. On the restated basis (item 15) that is Jan–Sep revenue 40,650 + 43,650 + 45,150 + 45,150 + 47,650 + 41,250 + 41,250 + 41,250 + 41,700 = 387,700.00 ✓. Year-end disclosure committed.
33: 
34: 7. **Opening A/R 92,650.00 — now nine months with zero collected.** All September billings were resolved in-month — the 23 continuing customers' 28,650.00 collected 09/20–09/26, the Vireo 27,000.00 wired 09/15, and the erroneous INV-2409 1,800.00 credited not collected (item 17) — yet not one opening receipt has appeared since January. Still no allowance: no credit-loss guidance exists in the library — a stated library gap, not a cited exemption. Nine months of perfect in-month collection alongside a dead opening balance keeps the aging question in front of the Board ahead of year-end.
35: 
36: 8. **Opening A/P 17,420.00 — still unpaid, now nine months old.** September bills (25,930.00, including the Harbor Law 2,500.00) were all paid within the month (ACH same-day/next-day, 09/05–09/10), so the only A/P left is the untouched opening balance.
37: 
38: 9. **Prepaid 9,600.00** (month_01 item 4) — no schedule has surfaced; still not amortized (checklist item 3 performed: reviewed, unsupported, carried).
39: 
40: 10. **Misfiled Dec-2025 `documents/bank_statement.csv`** (month_01 item 5) — decoy statement, unused; flag maintained.
41: 
42: 11. **Expense codes** (month_01 item 6) remain the controller-assigned scheme (no client chart of accounts); September mapping unchanged (AWS→5000, WeWork→5100, software→5200, Google Ads→5300, Gusto fees and Harbor Law→5400). September AWS 10,880.00 (+120.00) and Google Ads 3,650.00 (+50.00) continue the identical step-ups seen every month since April (AWS 10,280 → 10,400 → 10,520 → 10,640 → 10,760 → 10,880; Ads 3,400 → … → 3,650) — steady usage drift, and still vendor **bills**, not estimates. Harbor Law's third bill (item 2 closed) stays in 5400 for lack of a professional-fees code — this chart gap is now the only live piece of the old item 2 and is owned here.
43: 
44: 13. **Quarry Analytics Co (C-028) INV-2324 — 30,000.00 annual prepay; fifth of twelve 2,500.00 releases booked in September; 20,000.00 − 2,500.00 = 17,500.00 remains** (month_05 item 13). Treatment identical to Marigold (item 1): deferred at billing, 1/12 monthly (revenue_policy_memo #1; ASC 606-10-45-2; time-based series ASC 606-10-55-51). **Gap still open (stated, not asked):** "MSA v3.2" not in file; release inputs all on `documents/month_05/order_form_C-028.md`; treatment does not depend on it. If the MSA ever surfaces and contradicts the order form, revisit.
45: 
46: 14. **Saltline Hospitality (C-029) INV-2349 — 21,600.00 annual prepay; fourth of twelve 1,800.00 releases booked in September; 16,200.00 − 1,800.00 = 14,400.00 remains** (month_06 item 14). Deferred at billing, 1/12 monthly from the 2025-06-01 service start (revenue_policy_memo #1; ASC 606-10-45-2; ASC 606-10-55-51). **Gap still open (stated, not asked):** "MSA v3.2" not in file; inputs all on `documents/month_06/order_form_C-029.md`; treatment does not depend on it.
47: 
48: 15. **ASC 250 restatement vehicle — Pinecone Dental Group (C-025): February–June restated in July (open_items item 15 of the July package, with restated monthly tables); no new adjustment in September.** September booked the normal eighth-of-twelve 3,000.00 release (cumulative recognized 24,000.00 = 8 × 3,000.00; contract-basis deferred 36,000.00 → 12,000.00, Oct 2025–Jan 2026 at 3,000.00/month). Arithmetic: 36,000.00 ÷ 12 = 3,000.00; 24,000.00 + 12,000.00 = 36,000.00 ✓. The item stays open as the disclosure vehicle: year-end financial_statements.md will disclose the nature of the error, the restated Feb–Jun figures and the July catch-up entry (Dr 2200 / Cr 4000 15,000.00, JE-2025-07-06). The management-preference record (CEO's "book it in July and move on" — declined for the disclosure, books as requested) stands as logged in QUESTIONS.md round 3.
49: 
50: 16. **C-012 Alder Studios LLC — customer churn: cancellation effective 2025-08-31; September's re-bill was erroneous, credited in full (full write-up at new item 17); recurring run-rate confirmed at 23 customers / 28,650.00 per month.**
51:     - The churn substance is unchanged from August: `documents/month_08/email_cancellation_C-012.txt` (08/11, MSA §6.2), cancellation effective 08/31; August service fully performed and fully paid — first churn of 2025, no accounting adjustment either month.
52:     - September's addendum is the billing error (item 17): the 09/06 dispute email is now the second written touchpoint from this churned customer. The stated assumption from August stands (dated customer notice is sufficient evidence of cancellation; "MSA v3.2" §6.2 not in file — same gap as items 1/13/14/18; no exit consideration owed either way). The item stays open as the year-end **disclosure vehicle for churn** — first customer lost in 2025, read with items 7/8 for the business picture.
53:     - Management action, still outstanding: AR never answered the 08/11 "confirm receipt," and the September re-bill suggests nobody read the cancellation notice. Both are operational, not accounting.
54: 
55: ## Observation — fifth consecutive identical payroll register (NOT a new item)
56: 
57: The September payroll register is amount-for-amount identical to May, June, July and August (9 employees, gross 54,404.00, employer 5,076.00, net 48,200.00, remit 11,280.00). Consistent with the prior precedent, no item is opened: the close-checklist test is that payroll agrees to the register AND the bank, and it does to the penny on every leg (gross 54,404.00 = net 48,200.00 + withholdings 6,204.00; remit 11,280.00 = 6,204.00 + employer 5,076.00; bank legs 48,200.00 + 11,280.00 = 59,480.00 = total employer cost). Five identical months through a customer churn and a 27,000.00 prepay are recorded here so the pattern is on the record without being re-asked (client standing instruction: no open questions).
58: 
59: ## September result (context only; full statements at year-end)
60: 
61: Revenue 41,700.00 (recurring 28,650.00 — 30,450.00 billed less the INV-2409 credit 1,800.00, item 17 — + current releases 13,050.00: Trestle 2,000.00 + Marigold 1,500.00 + Quarry 2,500.00 + Saltline 1,800.00 + C-025 3,000.00 + Vireo 2,250.00 first release, item 18; **no prior-period correction this month**) − expenses 87,187.78 (opex 25,930.00 + payroll 59,480.00 + depreciation 1,777.78) = **September net loss (45,487.78)**. Restated nine-month 2025 net loss: **(375,870.02)** = restated eight-month (330,382.24) + (45,487.78). Book cash 93,280.00 = bank 93,280.00 — **difference 0.00** (all 32 statement lines recomputed; nothing forced). Deferred revenue roll-forward: opening 92,200.00 + new deferrals 27,000.00 (Vireo) − releases 13,050.00 = 106,150.00 = TB 2200 ✓. September opex (25,930.00) is above August's 23,260.00 solely because the third Harbor Law bill (2,500.00) fell in-quarter plus the standing usage steps (AWS +120.00, Ads +50.00, item 11) — nothing new and nothing estimated.
62: 
63: ## Checklist sign-off (library/close_checklist.md)
64: 
65: 1 ✓ invoices/receipts posted, A/R agreed (92,650.00 + 30,450.00 gross billings + 27,000.00 Vireo − 1,800.00 INV-2409 credit − 55,650.00 collections = 92,650.00; every September billing collected or credited in-month; opening still uncollected — item 7); 2 ✓ new deferral 27,000.00 (Vireo INV-2422) deferred at billing; releases booked 13,050.00 (Trestle 2,000.00 + Marigold 1,500.00 + Quarry 2,500.00 + Saltline 1,800.00 + C-025 3,000.00 + Vireo 2,250.00); roll-forward ties to TB 2200 (106,150.00); 3 ✓ bills posted (25,930.00, Harbor Law's third bill included — item 2 closed), prepaids reviewed (unsupported — item 9); 4 ✓ payroll agreed to register AND bank (59,480.00 both ways; two debits 09/25; single net-pay debit); 5 ✓ bank reconciled — all 32 lines recomputed (32/32 printed balances tie), difference 0.00, nothing forced, no ALDER STUDIOS LLC deposit exists (item 17's credit never touched cash); 6 ✓ depreciation 1,777.78 (1510 cumulative 37,333.02); 7 ✓ TB / roll-forward / this note; **no prior-period correction this month** — item 15's disclosure continues; INV-2409 arose and cleared inside September (ASC 606-10-25-1 + revenue_policy_memo #3, not ASC 250); item 2 closed on the third bill's arrival.

# Open items — October 2025 close — to the Board

Prior months: month_01 through month_09 closed **with open items**. Fifteen items are live (running numbers **1, 3, 5–11 and 13–18**; item 4 was closed in July, item 12 in May, item 2 in September). **No new open items arose in October and no correction of prior periods was required** — the INV-2434 error below arose and was cleared entirely within October, so no previously reported amount was misstated (not an ASC 250 event). Item 17, however, is **escalated** this month: the control gap September flagged has recurred.

## New this month

None. The live count stays at fifteen.

## Escalated this month

17. **INV-2434 — the cancelled C-012 was billed AGAIN in October: second consecutive ghost invoice after a written "stop" request. This is now a recurring control failure; billing-system suppression must be confirmed before the November run.**
    - **What happened:** despite the 08/11 cancellation effective 08/31 (item 16), the 09/06 dispute email, and September's full credit of INV-2409 (item 17 as opened last month), the billing system issued **INV-2434, 1,800.00, dated 2025-10-01, "Monthly subscription — October 2025"** to C-012 Alder Studios LLC — a second consecutive re-bill of a churned account. The customer wrote back 10/06 (`documents/month_10/email_dispute_C-012.txt`, subject "RE: Invoice — we cancelled in August"): "We received another invoice. We cancelled effective 8/31 (see our notice). **We will not be paying this. Please issue a credit and stop.**" — their second written touchpoint.
    - **October accounting (mirrors September exactly):** the billing run was posted gross as issued (JE-2025-10-01, A/R/4000 30,450.00, all 24 invoices) and INV-2434 was then **credited in full — Dr 4000 / Cr 1100 1,800.00, JE-2025-10-02 dated 10/06** — per revenue_policy_memo #3 ("Cancelled contracts: no revenue after the effective cancellation date; invoices issued in error are credited") and ASC 606-10-25-1: with the contract ended 08/31 there is **no October contract with C-012, no performance obligation, and no revenue**; the invoice alone creates none. Net October recurring billings are **28,650.00 across 23 customers** — the same run-rate September restored.
    - **No downstream residue — every leg verified:** the bank shows **no 1,800.00 deposit from Alder Studios LLC** (all 30 statement lines recomputed; the only Alder deposit is C-018's 900.00); the credit zeroes the receivable so INV-2434 **never ages in A/R** (A/R proof: 92,650.00 + 30,450.00 − 1,800.00 − 28,650.00 = 92,650.00); and revenue is stated net of the credit. October's books are right; the error died inside the month — hence again no ASC 250 question.
    - **Escalation (management action, before the November billing run):** September's control observation has now materialized — the suppression of C-012 either never happened or was never verified, and a written "stop" request was ignored. Two consecutive ghost invoices to a churned customer is a **recurring control failure**, costs goodwill (two angry emails on file), and will produce a third in November unless fixed at the source. **Management should confirm in writing that C-012 is suppressed in the billing system before the November run**, and that **the November run still contains C-018** (Alder Studios **Inc**, 900.00/month — a different, continuing customer; the name trap must not be suppressed by over-correction). No accounting content; monitored at the November close.
    - **Name trap re-guarded:** C-018 Alder Studios Inc was correctly billed (INV-2440) and paid 900.00 on 10/20 (bank row 7). Only the LLC was cancelled.

## Closed this month

None. (Item 2's absence this month is the opposite of a reopening: the Harbor Law bill is quarterly — paid 03/09, 06/09, 09/09 — so **no October bill is expected and none arrived**; the next is due 12/09. The quarterly cycle behaving as proven **confirms** the September closure.)

## Carried forward (client had no additional information; all remain stated assumptions)

1. **C-027 Marigold Schools Inc INV-2275 — 18,000.00 annual prepay; eighth of twelve 1,500.00 releases booked in October; 7,500.00 − 1,500.00 = 6,000.00 remains** (term 2025-03-01..2026-02-28, order form `documents/month_03/order_form_C-027.md`; releases per revenue_policy_memo #1, ASC 606-10-45-2 and 606-10-25-14(b)/25-27). **Gap still open (stated, not asked):** the referenced "MSA v3.2" is not in the file; the release inputs (price, start, term) are all on the order form itself, so treatment does not depend on it. If the MSA ever surfaces and contradicts the order form, revisit. (Same gap: Quarry — item 13 — Saltline — item 14 — the churn email, item 16 — and Vireo, item 18.)

3. **Trestle overlap assumption — renewal tenth of twelve releases booked (2,000.00); closing renewal balance 6,000.00 − 2,000.00 = 4,000.00; still the largest judgment in the books** (month_01 item 2; month_02 item 2; month_03 item 3; month_04 item 3). The stated renewal term (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) overlaps the prior contract Jan–May 2025; if the renewal actually runs Jun 2025–May 2026, cumulative over-recognition on the renewal line remains **frozen at its cap of 10,000.00** (reached end-May) — the exposure cannot grow, only unwind. Remaining 4,000.00 releases Nov–Dec 2025 (2 × 2,000.00) under the order-form reading; under the alternative reading the frozen 10,000.00 unwinds and releases run to May 2026 — **closing 4,000.00 either way at 10/31**.

5. **24,000.00 unidentified opening deferred revenue** (month_01 item 1) — still $0 recognized; carried in the roll-forward as "UNIDENTIFIED"; will never hit revenue without evidence of performance (ASC 606-10-45-2). No October bank item relates to it (statement fully matched, all 30 lines recomputed; no unusual credits at all this month).

6. **Opening trial balance oddities** (month_01 item 3) — 4000 opening credit 30,450.00 (2024 revenue never closed) and 3900 debit 205,953.00 (deficit) left exactly as received. Cumulative 4000 at 10/31 = 459,850.00, of which 2025 activity is 429,400.00 = 459,850.00 − 30,450.00. On the restated basis (item 15) that is Jan–Oct revenue 40,650 + 43,650 + 45,150 + 45,150 + 47,650 + 41,250 + 41,250 + 41,250 + 41,700 + 41,700 = 429,400.00 ✓. Year-end disclosure committed.

7. **Opening A/R 92,650.00 — now ten months with zero collected.** All October billings were resolved in-month — the 23 continuing customers' 28,650.00 collected 10/20–10/26 and the erroneous INV-2434 1,800.00 credited not collected (item 17) — yet not one opening receipt has appeared since January. Still no allowance: no credit-loss guidance exists in the library — a stated library gap, not a cited exemption. Ten months of perfect in-month collection alongside a dead opening balance keeps the aging question in front of the Board ahead of year-end.

8. **Opening A/P 17,420.00 — still unpaid, now ten months old.** October bills (23,600.00) were all paid within the month (ACH same-day, 10/05–10/09), so the only A/P left is the untouched opening balance.

9. **Prepaid 9,600.00** (month_01 item 4) — no schedule has surfaced; still not amortized (checklist item 3 performed: reviewed, unsupported, carried).

10. **Misfiled Dec-2025 `documents/bank_statement.csv`** (month_01 item 5) — decoy statement, unused; flag maintained.

11. **Expense codes** (month_01 item 6) remain the controller-assigned scheme (no client chart of accounts); October mapping unchanged (AWS→5000, WeWork→5100, software→5200, Google Ads→5300, Gusto fees→5400; no Harbor Law charge this month — quarterly cycle, next bill expected 12/09, item 2 closed). October AWS 11,000.00 (+120.00) and Google Ads 3,700.00 (+50.00) continue the identical step-ups seen every month since April (AWS 10,280 → 10,400 → 10,520 → 10,640 → 10,760 → 10,880 → 11,000; Ads 3,400 → … → 3,650 → 3,700) — steady usage drift, and still vendor **bills**, not estimates. The professional-fees code gap (why Harbor Law sat in 5400) remains owned here.

13. **Quarry Analytics Co (C-028) INV-2324 — 30,000.00 annual prepay; sixth of twelve 2,500.00 releases booked in October; 17,500.00 − 2,500.00 = 15,000.00 remains** (month_05 item 13). Treatment identical to Marigold (item 1): deferred at billing, 1/12 monthly (revenue_policy_memo #1; ASC 606-10-45-2; time-based series ASC 606-10-55-51). **Gap still open (stated, not asked):** "MSA v3.2" not in file; release inputs all on `documents/month_05/order_form_C-028.md`; treatment does not depend on it. If the MSA ever surfaces and contradicts the order form, revisit.

14. **Saltline Hospitality (C-029) INV-2349 — 21,600.00 annual prepay; fifth of twelve 1,800.00 releases booked in October; 14,400.00 − 1,800.00 = 12,600.00 remains** (month_06 item 14). Deferred at billing, 1/12 monthly from the 2025-06-01 service start (revenue_policy_memo #1; ASC 606-10-45-2; ASC 606-10-55-51). **Gap still open (stated, not asked):** "MSA v3.2" not in file; inputs all on `documents/month_06/order_form_C-029.md`; treatment does not depend on it.

15. **ASC 250 restatement vehicle — Pinecone Dental Group (C-025): February–June restated in July (open_items item 15 of the July package, with restated monthly tables); no new adjustment in October.** October booked the normal ninth-of-twelve 3,000.00 release (cumulative recognized 27,000.00 = 9 × 3,000.00; contract-basis deferred 36,000.00 → 9,000.00, Nov 2025–Jan 2026 at 3,000.00/month). Arithmetic: 36,000.00 ÷ 12 = 3,000.00; 27,000.00 + 9,000.00 = 36,000.00 ✓. The item stays open as the disclosure vehicle: year-end financial_statements.md will disclose the nature of the error, the restated Feb–Jun figures and the July catch-up entry (Dr 2200 / Cr 4000 15,000.00, JE-2025-07-06). The management-preference record (CEO's "book it in July and move on" — declined for the disclosure, books as requested) stands as logged in QUESTIONS.md round 3.

16. **C-012 Alder Studios LLC — customer churn: cancellation effective 2025-08-31; October's SECOND re-bill was erroneous, credited in full (full write-up at escalated item 17); recurring run-rate holding at 23 customers / 28,650.00 per month.**
    - The churn substance is unchanged from August/September: `documents/month_08/email_cancellation_C-012.txt` (08/11, MSA §6.2), cancellation effective 08/31; August service fully performed and fully paid — first churn of 2025, no accounting adjustment in any month since.
    - October's addendum is the recurrence (item 17 escalated): the 10/06 email is the **third** written touchpoint from this churned customer about billing they do not owe. The stated assumption stands (dated customer notice is sufficient evidence of cancellation; "MSA v3.2" §6.2 not in file — same gap as items 1/13/14/18; no exit consideration owed either way). The item stays open as the year-end **disclosure vehicle for churn** — first customer lost in 2025, read with items 7/8 for the business picture.
    - Management action, now twice outstanding: AR never answered the 08/11 "confirm receipt," September's re-bill showed nobody had read the cancellation notice, and October's re-bill shows nobody fixed the billing system either. Operational, not accounting — but escalated.

18. **Vireo Clinics PBC (C-030) INV-2422 — 27,000.00 annual prepay; second of twelve 2,250.00 releases booked in October; 24,750.00 − 2,250.00 = 22,500.00 remains** (opened month_09 item 18). Releases run Sep 2025–Aug 2026 per revenue_policy_memo #1, ASC 606-10-45-2 and the time-based-series guidance ASC 606-10-55-51. Arithmetic: 27,000.00 ÷ 12 = 2,250.00; closing 22,500.00 ✓ (roll-forward line verified). **Gap still open (stated, not asked):** "MSA v3.2" is not in the file; all release inputs (price, start, term) are on `documents/month_09/order_form_C-030.md`, so treatment does not depend on the MSA. If the MSA ever surfaces and contradicts the order form, revisit.

## Observation — sixth consecutive identical payroll register (NOT a new item)

The October payroll register is amount-for-amount identical to May, June, July, August and September (9 employees, gross 54,404.00, employer 5,076.00, net 48,200.00, remit 11,280.00). Consistent with the prior precedent, no item is opened: the close-checklist test is that payroll agrees to the register AND the bank, and it does to the penny on every leg (gross 54,404.00 = net 48,200.00 + withholdings 6,204.00; remit 11,280.00 = 6,204.00 + employer 5,076.00; bank legs 48,200.00 + 11,280.00 = 59,480.00 = total employer cost). Six identical months through a customer churn, two ghost invoices and a 27,000.00 prepay are recorded here so the pattern is on the record without being re-asked (client standing instruction: no open questions).

## October result (context only; full statements at year-end)

Revenue 41,700.00 (recurring 28,650.00 — 30,450.00 billed less the INV-2434 credit 1,800.00, item 17 — + current releases 13,050.00: Trestle 2,000.00 + Marigold 1,500.00 + Quarry 2,500.00 + Saltline 1,800.00 + C-025 3,000.00 + Vireo 2,250.00; **no prior-period correction this month**; no new deferrals this month) − expenses 84,857.78 (opex 23,600.00 + payroll 59,480.00 + depreciation 1,777.78) = **October net loss (43,157.78)**. Restated ten-month 2025 net loss: **(419,027.80)** = restated nine-month (375,870.02) + (43,157.78). Book cash 38,850.00 = bank 38,850.00 — **difference 0.00** (all 30 statement lines recomputed; nothing forced). Deferred revenue roll-forward: opening 106,150.00 + new deferrals 0.00 − releases 13,050.00 = 93,100.00 = TB 2200 ✓. October opex (23,600.00) is below September's 25,930.00 solely because no Harbor Law bill fell in the quarter (quarterly cycle, next 12/09) — the standing usage steps (AWS +120.00, Ads +50.00, item 11) continue; nothing new and nothing estimated.

## Checklist sign-off (library/close_checklist.md)

1 ✓ invoices/receipts posted, A/R agreed (92,650.00 + 30,450.00 gross billings − 1,800.00 INV-2434 credit − 28,650.00 collections = 92,650.00; every October billing collected or credited in-month; opening still uncollected — item 7); 2 ✓ no new deferrals this month; releases booked 13,050.00 (Trestle 2,000.00 + Marigold 1,500.00 + Quarry 2,500.00 + Saltline 1,800.00 + C-025 3,000.00 + Vireo 2,250.00); roll-forward ties to TB 2200 (93,100.00); 3 ✓ bills posted (23,600.00; no Harbor Law bill — quarterly cycle as proven, next expected 12/09, item 2 stays closed), prepaids reviewed (unsupported — item 9); 4 ✓ payroll agreed to register AND bank (59,480.00 both ways; two debits 10/25; single net-pay debit); 5 ✓ bank reconciled — all 30 lines recomputed (30/32-style line-by-line proof: 30/30 printed balances tie), difference 0.00, nothing forced, no ALDER STUDIOS LLC deposit exists (item 17's credit never touched cash); 6 ✓ depreciation 1,777.78 (1510 cumulative 39,110.80); 7 ✓ TB / roll-forward / this note; **no prior-period correction this month** — item 15's disclosure continues; INV-2434 arose and cleared inside October (ASC 606-10-25-1 + revenue_policy_memo #3, not ASC 250); item 17 **escalated** — second consecutive ghost invoice after a written stop request; management to confirm billing suppression before the November run.

                     D(m.group(3).replace(",", "")), D(m.group(4).replace(",", ""))))
ck("bank: 30 rows parse", len(rows) == 30)
bal = D("93280.00"); ties = 0; wds = []; dps = []

    if bal - amt == stated: bal -= amt; wds.append((desc, amt))

ck("bank: 23 deposits", len(dps) == 23)

ck("bank: deposits total 28,650.00", sum(a for _, a in dps) == D("28650.00"))

ck("bills: no Harbor Law in October (quarterly cycle)",

        "Notion": ("5200", D("1460")), "Google Ads": ("5300", D("3700")),

g, emp, net, rem = (D(str(pr[k])) for k in ("gross", "employer_taxes", "net_pay", "taxes_remitted")) \

if g is None:
    vals = {k: D(str(v)) for k, v in pr.items() if isinstance(v, (int, float, str)) and re.match(r"^\d+(\.\d+)?$", str(v))}
    g, emp, net, rem = vals.get("gross", D(0)), vals.get("employer_taxes", D(0)), vals.get("net_pay", D(0)), vals.get("taxes_remitted", D(0))
ck("payroll: gross 54,404 net 48,200 employer 5,076 remit 11,280",
   g == D("54404") and net == D("48200") and emp == D("5076") and rem == D("11280"))
wh = g - net
ck("payroll: withholdings 6,204 and remit = withheld + employer",
   wh == D("6204") and rem == wh + emp)
ck("payroll: bank legs present 48,200 + 11,280",
   ("GUSTO NET PAY", D("48200")) in wd_set and ("GUSTO TAX", D("11280")) in wd_set)

em = open(f"{DOC}/email_dispute_C-012.txt").read()
ck("dispute email: refuses payment + demands credit", "not be paying" in em and "issue a credit" in em)

je = json.load(open(f"{DEL}/month_10/journal_entries.json"))
je = je["entries"] if isinstance(je, dict) else je

ck("JE: every entry self-balances",
   all(abs(sum(l["debit"] - l["credit"] for l in e["lines"])) < 0.005 for e in je))
side = sum(l["debit"] for e in je for l in e["lines"])
ck("JE: 182,407.78 per side", abs(side - 182407.78) < 0.005)
def net_act(entries):
    act = defaultdict(D)
    for e in entries:
        for l in e["lines"]:
            act[l["account"]] += D(str(l["debit"])) - D(str(l["credit"]))
    return act

       "2000": D(0), "2200": -D("13050"), "4000": -(D("30450") - D("1800") + D("13050")),
       "5000": D("11000"), "5100": D("7200"), "5200": D("1460"), "5300": D("3700"),
       "5400": D("240"), "6000": D("54404"), "6100": D("5076"), "6200": D("1777.78"),
       "1510": -D("1777.78")}
for a, v in exp.items():
    ck(f"JE activity {a} = {v}", act.get(a, D(0)) == v)
ck("JE: no activity outside expected accounts", set(act) == set(exp))

tbX = json.load(open(f"{DEL}/month_10/trial_balance.json"))["accounts"]
ok = True
for a in set(tb9) | set(tbX):
    s9 = D(str(tb9.get(a, {}).get("debit", 0))) - D(str(tb9.get(a, {}).get("credit", 0)))
    sX = D(str(tbX.get(a, {}).get("debit", 0))) - D(str(tbX.get(a, {}).get("credit", 0)))
    if sX - s9 != act.get(a, D(0)): ok = False

ck("TB 1100 = 92,650 (A/R proof 92,650+30,450-1,800-28,650)", abs(tbX["1100"]["debit"] - 92650.0) < 0.005)

ck("TB 2200 = 93,100.00", abs(tbX["2200"]["credit"] - 93100.0) < 0.005)

# ---------- 9. rollforward ----------
rf9 = json.load(open(f"{DEL}/month_09/deferred_revenue_rollforward.json"))["contracts"]
rfX = json.load(open(f"{DEL}/month_10/deferred_revenue_rollforward.json"))
ANN = {"Marigold": ("1500", "18000"), "Pinecone": ("3000", "36000"), "Quarry": ("2500", "30000"),

        if D(ann[1]) / 12 != D(ann[0]): rel_ok = False

# ---------- 11. documents text checks ----------

for s in ("38,850.00", "93,280.00", "0.00", "ALDER STUDIOS LLC", "HARBOR", "30/30"):

otxt = open(f"{DEL}/month_10/open_items.md").read()
for s in ("INV-2434", "INV-2440", "escalat", "Fifteen", "1, 3, 5\u201311", "92,650.00 + 30,450.00 \u2212 1,800.00 \u2212 28,650.00",

    if s == "fifth|sixth":

    else:
        ck(f"open_items contains {s!r}", s in otxt or s.lower() in otxt.lower())
stxt = open(f"{DEL}/STATUS.md").read()
for s in ("month_10", "October 2025", "COMPLETE WITH OPEN ITEMS", "1,259,480.80", "182,407.78",
          "38,850.00", "INV-2434", "(43,157.78)", "(419,027.80)", "93,100.00", "escalat"):

# ---------- 12. prior months intact ----------
for mm in ("01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06", "07", "08", "09"):
